options.label: Describe the problem in one sentence without code
options.description: Sometimes stepping back and writing the problem in plain English — without any code — reveals the fix. What is the bug actually doing, in words? Often the sentence itself contains the answer.

options.label: Write down what you know for certain and what you're guessing
options.description: Split what you know into two lists: 'confirmed facts' and 'assumptions I haven't verified'. Debug the assumptions first — they're usually where the bug is hiding.

options.label: Describe the last state where it worked correctly
options.description: When was the last time this worked? What changed between then and now? A precise 'last known good' state is the fastest path to isolating where things went wrong.
